name: fractal
description: A personal agent coordinator desktop app
author: Pablo Varela

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.rebuild:electron: mise exec -- pnpm exec electron-builder install-app-deps && mise exec -- pnpm exec electron-rebuild --force --only=better-sqlite3,node-pty
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "mise exec -- pnpm dev" "mise exec -- pnpm exec wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:7666 && ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7666 mise exec -- pnpm exec electron ."
scripts.electron:dev:build: mise exec -- pnpm run rebuild:electron && astro build && mise exec -- pnpm exec electron .
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: mise exec -- pnpm run rebuild:electron && astro build && mise exec -- pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:x64: mise exec -- pnpm run rebuild:electron && astro build && mise exec -- pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: mise exec -- pnpm run rebuild:electron && astro build && mise exec -- pnpm exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb --arm64 --publish never
